verdict.rationale: Make stores connections at team scope; the API retrieves 'all connections for a team.' It also documents a per-connection access list (entity ACL) of principals granted a role, which covers central storage, team sharing, and per-credential access control. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the available roles and permission semantics, UI-level docs on sharing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can store connection credentials centrally, share them with my team, and control who can use which credential

citations.quote: Retrieves a collection of all connections for a team with a given ID.
The following endpoints let you view and manage the access list (entity ACL) of a connection — the principals granted a role on it.
